name: Soyuz TM-15
about: Soyuz TM-15 (1992-046A), a crewed vehicle (7K-STM), launched 1992 Jul 27. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1992 Aug 27), held fixed
docked to S16609; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
